title: A Scholarship for the Prom
author: Sebastian Okafor
blurb: Yara Halloran, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
